subject: Retention & evidence follow-up: SOC 2, DPA, audit logs, pen-test
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Alex Bryant <alex.bryant@clearbank.com>, security@clearbank.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-17T14:12:00-04:00
Subject: Follow-up: retention, SOC 2 scoping & pen test evidence (post-call recap)

Alex / security team — thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth from our side.

Summary of pain points and goals we captured:
- Retention: ClearBank needs audit logs and transaction metadata retained and queryable for regulatory review; target retention window discussed: 12 months preferred, minimum 6 months acceptable.
- SOC 2: You want Redwood to provide SOC 2 Type II report or scoped SOC 2 artifacts relevant to hosted inference surface (authn, audit logs, change control).
- Pen test evidence: Redacted copy of recent penetration test report (or executive summary) and indication of ongoing cadence.
- DPA & contractual: Need explicit retention clause and obligations on log export and incident notification timelines.
- Operational controls: KMS usage, encryption-at-rest/in-transit, and ability to produce obfuscated audit-log samples for upstream compliance review.

What Redwood will do (actions / owners / ETA):
1) Provide an artifact index (SOC 2 report pointers, audit log samples, logging configuration docs, KMS attestation) — Rafael to deliver by 2026-05-20.
2) Produce a proposed DPA amendment language snippet for retention and log access — Marissa to draft by 2026-05-21.
3) Schedule a technical deep-dive (engineering + security) to walk through log format, redaction approach, and export mechanics — propose week of 2026-05-24; Grace to coordinate slots.
4) If required, provide a redacted pen-test executive summary (where allowed) — Rafael to confirm availability and redaction constraints with the security team.

Attachments: call-recording-20260517.mp3 (audio) and internal meeting notes.

Ask from ClearBank: please confirm the preferred retention window (6 or 12 months), any required log fields/schema we should prioritize, and whether a redacted pen-test summary is acceptable or you need a signed NDA for the full redacted report.

Thanks — appreciate the clarity, and we want to keep momentum so procurement can proceed.

— Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182
Redwood Inference

---
From: Alex Bryant <alex.bryant@clearbank.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: security@clearbank.com
Date: 2026-05-17T20:08:00+01:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: retention, SOC 2 scoping & pen test evidence (post-call recap)

Thanks Rafael — clear summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Retention: our baseline for production telemetry and audit trails is 12 months; for some regulated flows we may ask for 24 months but we can start with 12 and discuss extensions if needed.
- SOC 2: we expect either a full SOC 2 Type II report covering relevant controls or a set of mapped artifacts (control descriptions + test procedures) if a full report is not available. For initial procurement we often accept a redacted SOC 2 report + mapping doc.
- Pen test: redacted executive summary is fine for the first pass. We will need a redacted PDF that removes customer-specific info. If Redwood requires, we can execute an NDA before accepting more detailed artifacts.
- DPA: we will share our standard DPA excerpt on retention and access — attached as ClearBank_DPA_Summary.pdf for reference. This is not final redlines, just internal guidance on what contracting will expect.

Proposed next steps from ClearBank:
1) We confirm 12 months as the initial retention window.
2) We'll share a short list of mandatory log fields by Wednesday 2026-05-19 (security@clearbank.com will send).
3) Once we receive Redwood's artifact index, our procurement team will map gaps and revert with any required exceptions.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Bryant
Head of Security Operations | ClearBank
alex.bryant@clearbank.com

- Audit log sample: sanitized CSV export with typical fields (timestamp, request_id, user_id obfuscated, model_id, route, action) — ETA 2026-05-21.
- DPA language: proposed retention clause and access procedures — ETA 2026-05-21 (Marissa owner).
- Pen-test summary: redacted executive summary or certified attestation of recent test cadence — ETA 2026-05-22 (subject to redaction review).
- KMS/Encryption attestation: architecture note and key rotation policy excerpt — ETA 2026-05-21.

If acceptable we'll: (a) upload the artifacts to a secure Share link (Drive) and (b) share a DocuSign envelope for the DPA snippet if you want to start contractual language reviews in parallel.

Links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/record/DB-9834 (deal record) and DocuSign track: https://www.docusign.com/track/0a1b2c3d

Please flag any gating items. If procurement needs a 1:1 to review the DPA language, Marissa can coordinate.

Thanks — Rafael

Rafael / team — appreciate the fast turnaround. Confirming next steps on our end:

- We will accept the 12-month retention baseline for initial contract.
- security@clearbank.com will send the required log field list by EOD today.
- We are OK to receive a redacted pen-test executive summary. Once we have that, our security team will either accept it or request an NDA before a more detailed review.

I attached the ClearBank-Pentest-2025-redacted.pdf sample (this is our vendor's redacted copy for reference only) so you can see the level of redaction we expect.

Thanks — Alex
